Playbook.name: Defender DLP — Bulk Sensitive-Data Movement by a Single User - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: Microsoft DLP flagged one user moving many distinct sensitive documents (>=10 titles). Triage: data exfiltration, or heavy legitimate document work by a data-role user?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Bulk sensitive-data movement is exfiltration of regulated/confidential banking data.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Defender XDR alerts via Elastic Agent (verified live). Fields: m365_defender.alert.detection_source, .severity, .status, .title, .category, threat.tactic.name, user.name, host.name, m365_defender.alert.evidence.device_dns_name. INGEST LAG ~26 min - 4h windows + event.ingested override.

Signal.Name: Bulk Sensitive-Data Movement by a Single

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the bulk DLP activity is exfiltration or legitimate data-role work.

Step.name: DLP documents and devices for the user
Step.Purpose: The document count, titles and devices distinguish exfil from routine work.
Step.Query: FROM logs-m365_defender.alert* | WHERE m365_defender.alert.detection_source == "microsoftDataLossPrevention" AND user.name == "$user" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, m365_defender.alert.title, m365_defender.alert.evidence.device_dns_name | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: Many distinct sensitive titles moved in a short window, especially to removable/cloud/personal destinations, suggests exfil. A data-analyst/finance role handling many documents routinely is benign. Note the device.

Step.name: Is this outside the user's normal pattern
Step.Purpose: A spike vs a consistently high-volume role user distinguishes exfil from routine work.
Step.Query: FROM logs-m365_defender.alert* | WHERE m365_defender.alert.detection_source == "microsoftDataLossPrevention" AND user.name == "$user" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, m365_defender.alert.title, m365_defender.alert.severity | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: Correlate with the user's role and history. A sudden spike, or movement after a compromise indicator, is exfil.

Node.Condition: Bulk sensitive-document movement to removable/cloud/personal destinations, or outside the user's role.
A data-role user (analyst/finance) with routine high-volume document work.
A DLP policy over-classifying benign documents.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-DEFDLP-VOLUME, INV-02-DEFDLP-CONTEXT to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: Routine high-volume document work by a data role.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the role/work; close as benign_activity.

TruePositive.Definition: Data exfiltration by or via the user.

Indicators.Item: Bulk sensitive docs to risky destinations.

SOCAction.Item: Engage DLP/compliance; review the moved data; reset the account if compromised; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A DLP policy over-classifying benign documents.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the user and destinations; if exfil, involve DLP/compliance.
Reset the account if compromise is indicated.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Review the moved data with DLP/compliance; reset the account if compromised; open IR.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Tune DLP policies; enforce egress controls; educate data-role users.

QualityChecks.Check: Defender ingest lag ~26 min - 4h window + override.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Exfil scoped with compliance; account secured; data reviewed.
